# Spec: Check which rights an endpoint needs

[Specs](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/check-your-rights.md)

**Start:** `/identity/rights`  
**Persona:** A developer working out why an API call is refused  
**Goal:** See the access each endpoint needs and check the current user against a right.

**Table 1 — Acceptance criteria**

| Step | Action | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Read the endpoint table | The table lists the rights.demo endpoint with access rights. |
| 2 | Check a right | A result is shown with the rights the user holds. |

Source: `e2e/journeys.ts` (journey `check-your-rights`). Each expected result is asserted by the step's `run` function.
